title: Build and read control codes
description:
Implement `ctlCode(deviceType, function, method, access)`, which packs the four fields exactly as the `CTL_CODE` macro does:

```
(deviceType << 16) | (access << 14) | (function << 2) | method
```

and `decode(code)`, which splits a control code back into its fields.

Also write `isVendorCode(code)`: true when the device type is at least `0x8000` **and** the function is at least `0x800`, the ranges set aside for drivers other than Microsoft's.

```
ctlCode(0x8001, 0x801, 0, 3)  = 0x8001E004
decode(0x8001E004)            = device 0x8001, function 0x801, method 0, access 3
```
hints: Encoding is shifting each field to its position and OR-ing them together.
Decoding is the reverse: shift each field down to bit 0 and mask its width: 2 bits (`0x3`) for method and access, 12 bits (`0xFFF`) for the function, 16 bits for the device type.
